findings.mechanism: The settled cognition reading combines with the perfect form and the following known content, keeping the appeal in recognition rather than instruction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears why the speakers say you know instead of explaining the facts afresh.
findings.containment: The finding stays with the local cognition contrast and does not activate the wider knowledge-field meanings.

epistemic.reason: Trusted support retains the Form I distinction while narrowing its wider lexical extension.

findings.title: The first mā targets motive
findings.claim: The first {ar:مَا, tr:mā, gloss:değil} reaches through {ar:جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ, tr:jiʾnā li-nufsida, gloss:bozgunculuk etmek için geldik} and denies the purpose of coming.
findings.mechanism: Negator scope covers the arrival-plus-purpose unit, while the arrival verb remains the event around which the purpose is disputed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the brothers concede their presence while contesting the reason assigned to it.
findings.containment: The negative scope is limited to the supplied purpose construction and does not erase the arrival form.

epistemic.reason: Local syntax and the supplied first-purpose-negation support directly agree.

findings.title: The first mā prepares the second
findings.claim: The first negator sets up a two-panel defense whose second panel begins with another mā after the conjunction.
findings.mechanism: The later repeated negation confirms the earlier scope as one member of a formally parallel pair: purpose first, identity second.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates the second denial as a new panel rather than a restatement.
findings.containment: The architecture preserves both denials and does not make their parallel form erase their different predicates.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies both negators and the coordination that links them.

findings.title: Coming is admitted
findings.claim: The perfect first-plural {ar:جِئْنَا, tr:jiʾnā, gloss:geldik} states the brothers' completed arrival in a bare frame.
findings.mechanism: The verb carries the first-plural subject and has no object or brought-item complement, leaving arrival itself as the admitted event.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sentence separate where they came from what they came to do.
findings.containment: The claim is about this verb's local valency and does not deny that the same root can take other frames elsewhere.

epistemic.reason: Perfect morphology, first plural, and absent object/complement are directly supplied.

findings.title: Motion becomes motive
findings.claim: The arrival verb is bracketed by negation and purpose, so the sentence uses motion to litigate intention.
findings.mechanism: Mā precedes the arrival and the purpose lām follows it; the verb becomes the hinge between an admitted movement and a disputed aim.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence turn a simple coming into a question of why the speakers came.
findings.containment: The hinge retains the ordinary arrival meaning and adds the motive relation supplied by its syntax.

epistemic.reason: The focus sequence and attachment evidence directly establish the bracketing.

findings.title: The purpose lām makes intent the issue
findings.claim: The purpose lām in {ar:لِنُفْسِدَ, tr:li-nufsida, gloss:bozgunculuk etmek için} makes deliberate intent the issue attached to coming.
findings.mechanism: It governs the following subjunctive corruption verb and fuses purpose with action after the arrival verb.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a denial of motive rather than a flat denial that any corruption ever happened.
findings.containment: The purpose relation remains inside the first clause and does not settle the separate identity denial.

epistemic.reason: The supplied particle analysis and purpose support are direct.

findings.title: Prior knowledge carries the appeal
findings.claim: The oath and perfect-form appeal can shift the burden of the defense onto what the addressees already know.
findings.mechanism: The attributed divine-name oath frame meets the attributed prior-knowledge reading of the second-person perfect, so innocence is presented as recoverable from shared observation rather than as a new self-report.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the speakers make the accusers' own recognition part of the defense.
findings.containment: This remains qualified attributed contextual evidence: it deepens the ordinary sworn denial without replacing it or inventing an independent lexical gloss.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor and word coordinates are supplied, but reader identity and HFT segmentation remain legacy_unbound and attributed.

findings.containment: The unresolved arrival branch remains attributed without an invented gloss; all four traces qualify the ordinary two-clause defense rather than replacing it.
